selection_rule: Purposeful first tranche: six consequential aviation dismissals with firm earlier wording and inspectable documentary roots, two competing materials judgments, and two affirmative criticisms already linked to preservation/chronology audits. Selection uses consequence, verdict strength and practical testability; not a random sample or estimate of overall error rates. Prefer exact claim units over broad summaries. Both dismissal and affirmation selected. Other film/policy/engineering claims remain in existing register.
pre_freeze_exposure: Earlier assessment and audit work were known; initial public-source intake previews of the four starting sources were exposed before this freeze. This is not blinded preregistration. Freeze precedes new local source comparisons and revised verdicts; no claimed prospective ignorance of results.

claims.exact_original_wording: | **Flight 77 did not strike the Pentagon** | **Contradicted by the combined evidence.** Flight-recorder and radar reconstruction, the structural damage path, recovered aircraft material, photographs, and eyewitness accounts support an airliner impact. The case does not depend on obtaining a cinematic security-camera view. [ntsb.gov](https://www.ntsb.gov/about/Documents/Flight_Path_Study_AA77.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **Flight 93 landed in Cleveland** | **Contradicted by the combined crash evidence.** The early landing story does not explain the aircraft’s recorder, radar path, recovered material, and occupant identifications. Confusing another aircraft or repeating an erroneous bulletin cannot relocate that evidence. [United Airlines Flight 93](https://home.nps.gov/flni/learn/historyculture/upload/Flight_Path_Study_of_Flight_93_508.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **It was shot down** | **Not supported by the examined record.** The recorders document a terminal sequence consistent with a struggle and deliberate control inputs. A missile explanation needs affirmative evidence of an external strike. It cannot be established merely from the fact that officials considered shootdown authority elsewhere. [United Airlines Flight 93](https://home.nps.gov/flni/learn/historyculture/upload/Flight_Path_Study_of_Flight_93_508.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **The final three minutes were erased** | **Contradicted.** The public cockpit transcript reaches the terminal event around 10:03:10; the flight-data study places impact at approximately 10:03:11. The claim depends on first establishing a later crash time against that combined record. [coop.vaed.uscourts.gov](https://coop.vaed.uscourts.gov/moussaoui/exhibits/prosecution/P200056T.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **The calls were impossible with 2001 cellphones** | **False as a general explanation.** Most documented Flight 93 calls used installed Airfones: 35 of 37 calls, according to the NPS reconstruction. Treating all of them as cellular calls invalidates the argument’s premise. [nps.gov](https://www.nps.gov/flni/learn/historyculture/phone-calls-and-seating-chart.htm?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **The FBI proved Barbara Olson never called** | **False as stated, but attribution uncertainty is real.** A zero-duration entry concerns an unsuccessful attempt. Other connected calls had incompletely identified recipients; the Commission acknowledged that precise matching was unresolved. Ted Olson’s secretary, Lori Keyton, separately told the FBI she answered and transferred two calls identifying the caller as Barbara. This supports calls reaching the office without pretending every electronic record has been perfectly matched. [911commission.gov](https://www.911commission.gov/report/911Report_Notes.htm?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **Harrit’s red/gray chips** | **A real laboratory study, with a disputed interpretation.** The authors performed microscopy, elemental analysis, and calorimetry on samples from four civilian dust collections. The study deserves examination; it does not by itself establish an installed demolition system. [Jones_TOCPJ](https://benthamopenarchives.com/contents/pdf/TOCPJ/TOCPJ-2-7.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **Millette’s contrary findings** | **Relevant, but not an exact same-sample replication.** Millette reported epoxy, iron oxide, and kaolin in other chips, without elemental aluminum. He did not test Harrit’s actual specimens and did not identify an exact source product. Describing his work as conclusively identifying every disputed chip as a particular WTC paint would overstate it. [911facts.dk](https://www.911facts.dk/resources/Millette/9119ProgressReport022912_rev1_030112web.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **The early FAA/NORAD account was false** | **A strong, legitimate criticism.** The Commission’s reconstruction rejected important earlier claims about notification and response. Recordings showed that the initial public chronology made the response look more coherent than it was. Establishing an inaccurate account of failure does not, on its own, establish participation in the attack. [9-11commission.gov](https://www.9-11commission.gov/archive/hearing12/9-11Commission_Hearing_2004-06-17.htm?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

claims.exact_original_wording: | **Steel was disposed of before adequate investigation** | **A valid evidence-preservation criticism.** Potentially useful material was lost. Nevertheless, investigators examined recovered steel; it is false that there was no materials investigation. WTC 7’s lack of confidently identified retained steel is a particularly important limitation. [tms.org](https://www.tms.org/pubs/journals/jom/0711/banovic-0711.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
